   Running E2E tests with Detox on Android   #1326 New issue Copy link New issue Copy link Closed Closed Running E2E tests with Detox on Android #1326 Copy link Description philiplindberg opened  on Mar 14, 2023 Issue body actions I'm trying to configure some detox e2e tests for my react native app, but I can't figure out how to target the card fields inside the payment sheet on Android using  Detox matchers . On iOS, I'm able to use the  by.label  and  by.type  matchers to target each card field (see code snippet below), but I'm not sure what the equivalent matchers would be for Android. 
 I'd like to be able to target payment sheet card fields by some kind of ID or label so I can run e2e detox tests for both iOS and Android. 
 On iOS, I'm able to write tests like the following: 
 await   element ( by . label ( 'Card number' ) . and ( by . type ( 'UITextField' ) ) ) . typeText ( '4242424242424242' ) 
 await   element ( by . label ( 'expiration date' ) . and ( by . type ( 'UITextField' ) ) ) . typeText ( '12/25' ) 
 await   element ( by . label ( 'CVC' ) . and ( by . type ( 'UITextField' ) ) ) . typeText ( '123' ) 
 await   element ( by . label ( 'ZIP' ) . and ( by . type ( 'UITextField' ) ) ) . typeText ( '12345' ) 
 await   element ( by . type ( '_TtCC18StripePaymentSheet13ConfirmButton9BuyButton' ) ) . tap ( ) Reactions are currently unavailable Activity charliecruzan-stripe   commented   on   Mar 17, 2023   charliecruzan-stripe on Mar 17, 2023 Collaborator More actions Hi! You should be able to use the  testID  prop for this. charliecruzan-stripe closed this  as  completed on Mar 17, 2023 philiplindberg   commented   on   Mar 20, 2023   philiplindberg on Mar 20, 2023 Author More actions So which  testID s should I be using when targeting fields within the payment sheet? This doesn't seem to be documented anywhere, and it doesn't seem like I can assign custom  testID s to the payment sheet or its fields. 
 When looking at  stripe's internal e2e tests  using Maestro, it seems like you're targeting the payment sheet fields by their placeholder text and not  testID . Should I be doing something similar when running Detox tests? charliecruzan-stripe   commented   on   Mar 27, 2023   charliecruzan-stripe on Mar 27, 2023 Last edited by  charliecruzan-stripe Collaborator More actions Ah sorry about that! Was mistakenly assuming you were referring to  CardField  |  CardForm 
 For Payment Sheet, you are correct in that you should be going by the text-  the native Stripe iOS library does the same in it's UI tests . Does detox's  by.label()  function not work for you on Android? philiplindberg   commented   on   Mar 28, 2023   philiplindberg on Mar 28, 2023 Author More actions Using detox's  by.label()  matcher doesn't seem to work on android (works fine on ios though). For example, the following matcher does  not  work on android: 
 await   element ( by . label ( 'Card number' ) ) . typeText ( '4242424242424242' )   // doesn't work 
 Detox's  by.type()  and  by.text()  matchers don't seem to work either: 
 await   element ( by . type ( 'android.widget.EditText[@text="Card number"]' ) ) . typeText ( '4242424242424242' )   // doesn't work 
 await   element ( by . text ( 'Card number' ) ) . typeText ( '4242424242424242' )   // doesn't work 
 Detox's  by.label()  matcher  does  work on ios though: 
 await   element ( by . label ( 'Card number' ) . and ( by . type ( 'UITextField' ) ) ) . typeText ( '4242424242424242' )   // does work 
 @charliecruzan-stripe  any thoughts? charliecruzan-stripe   commented   on   Mar 28, 2023   charliecruzan-stripe on Mar 28, 2023 Collaborator More actions Hm, i'm not sure why that wouldn't be working. Although it looks like this has happened in the past to detox:  wix/Detox#1539 yannisvetster   commented   on   Apr 26, 2023   yannisvetster on Apr 26, 2023 More actions @philiplindberg  Were you able to get this working? 
I'm running into the same issue where on Android, Detox isn't able to find the elements in the payment sheet. 
 "detox": "^19.7.1",
